purpose: Last discriminating module-level experiment of this wave. Prior feasible coverage, gates, aggregators and backup model did not transfer, full correction on fixed graph was an oracle. Test modest isolated changes on the actual adaptive C0 to decide what to build first.
population: All four primary banks (DS1 and 3 GPT) and both DS0 archives where present, 26/10 tasks. Every bank gets its own true C0 control path.
opportunity: Assign each task/undirected pair to one of four deterministic folds by sha256(task + separator + canonical pair). Same hash across banks/jobs/doses. In one simulation only a single fold is eligible; average four folds before task weighting. Eligibility uses no outcomes. No tuning.
arms: O unmodified actual C0. D (direction): on eligible originally accepted (.7+, C0 parse valid) pairs supply true execution direction with unchanged original confidence; preserve ties and other raw records. A (abstention): on eligible originally not accepted strict pairs only return true direction with confidence=.7, preserving all other feedback incl actual ties. Interpretable as a what-if source that is correct on this subset; not implementable without labels. For each arm rerun real tournament incl rematch, cache and B cap; measure achieved unique reads, target/opportunity and changes actually used, loss and hit. Direction and abstention arms receive the same ex-ante 1/4 fraction of edge addresses, but actionable errors/abstentions and realized paths differ. Mean unique reads may vary, no claim of identical actual cost.
metrics: g_D=R(O)-R(D), g_A=R(O)-R(A), g_D-g_A = R(A)-R(D), paired per job averaged over all four folds then task, 10000 cluster repeats seed 20261108093; report DS1, each GPT and pooled, two DS0 individually (late full vs early 10), common10 sensitivity where feasible. Verify noneligible entries unchanged, partial interventions strictly gated, frozen controls reproduce.
decision: No more candidate or threshold search in this wave. Primary comparison for development design direction: require gain >=.01 and interval lower>0 for same mechanism across full DS1, late DS0 and task-first GPT pool. If one qualifies prioritize corresponding judge module. If both qualify and D-A direction stable across these families, choose larger attainable diagnostic opportunity with actual feasibility caveat. If ordering/intervals ambiguous, retain C0 and prioritize a minimal executable judge-direction or abstention verifier prototype using known failure source and current controls, label it an engineering/research priority, not a demonstrated winner. Do not infer a superior production policy from the oracle. Do not rerank previous arms by discovery p-values.
budget: One offline run; 4 disjoint folds x 2 interventions per bank x all admitted jobs. 600s per invocation; 0 API, training or GPU. No changes to frozen code/inputs. The proposed subsequent implementation must make label-blind predictions; independent task test and cost comparison are its acceptance step.
